extracted.intended_audience: readers of Marmont's memoirs; historians and military officers interested in Napoleonic-era orders and administration
extracted.subtask_description: Collection of Napoleonic-era military letters, orders, and Marmont's memoir prose giving operational, logistical, and administrative prescriptions and principles for field armies and provincial governance. Includes tactical guidance, supply and engineering requirements, cantonment/camp rules, reconnaissance/map standards, and principles for territorial administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preserve supply depots and magazines
rubrics_metrics.description: «L'Empereur vous recommande de bien conserver les manutentions et les magasins.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep magazines and logistical stores secure and maintained; conserve important local production (e.g., «Il y a à Znaïm une fabrique de tabac très-importante; il faut la conserver»).

rubrics_metrics.name: Collect postal/official correspondence promptly
rubrics_metrics.description: «Vous ne nous avez pas envoyé les lettres de la poste: il faut les enlever partout.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure postal letters and official correspondence are collected everywhere and forwarded without delay so higher command receives timely information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use redundant, spaced reconnaissance parties
rubrics_metrics.description: Napoléon reproaches sending a single engineer and states the rules: send three officers spaced by half an hour.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When dispatching an officer for reconnaissance, send multiple (e.g., three) at staggered intervals (half-hour apart) to reduce risk of losing all reconnaissance capability to misadventure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain cavalry posts to mark routes and relay news
rubrics_metrics.description: Napoléon: «Comment n'avez-vous pas laissé des postes de cavalerie pour jalonner la route et pour que vos nouvelles arrivassent promptement?»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deploy cavalry posts along key routes to mark/cover roads and guarantee rapid transmission of reports and orders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid serious engagement until superior support is within reach
rubrics_metrics.description: Napoléon: «ayez soin de ne rien engager de sérieux jusqu'à ce que je sois à portée de vous.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not commit to major actions until expected supporting forces are close enough to influence the fight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Send knowledgeable officer with position sketch for reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Napoléon requests: «Envoyez-moi quelqu'un qui connaisse bien votre position et celle de l'ennemi. Quel est le village pris et repris? Faites-m'en un croquis que vous m'enverrez en route.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reporting, forward an officer familiar with the local and enemy dispositions and include a sketch map of contested villages/positions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select and hold positions using terrain, defences, and reserves
rubrics_metrics.description: Marmont's justification for holding his position: river unfordable at some points, front covered by a ravine and an offensif/defensif village, right anchored by crenelated farms serving as strongpoints, large cavalry reserve.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose positions where natural features (rivers, ravines), fortified villages/farms, and reserves (cavalry/artillery) give a defensible system; factor in enemy movements and potential support from nearby friendly corps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain observation detachments on river banks
rubrics_metrics.description: Marmont: «j'ai eu constamment deux escadrons occupés à observer les bords de la Taya, depuis la position que j'occupe jusqu'à deux lieues en arrière de nous.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep dedicated squadrons/units observing riverbanks and approaches over a defined depth (e.g., two leagues) to monitor enemy movements.

rubrics_metrics.name: When moving through a district, establish civil administration and leave garrison
rubrics_metrics.description: Order: when sending the Bavarian division to Lintz, traverse Ober-Manhartsberg and 'installer l'intendance et le commandant de la province'; 'laisser, en passant, un bataillon au chef-lieu de la province.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: On passage through a province, install an intendant and provincial commander to establish administration and leave a battalion at the provincial capital to secure control and logistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Camp troops by division separated by 1–2 leagues; HQ in chief town
rubrics_metrics.description: Order: 'vous établirez votre quartier général dans le chef-lieu de ce cercle, et vous ferez baraquer votre corps d'armée par division, à une ou deux lieues de distance.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Billet/encamp forces by division with spacing of one to two leagues to facilitate administration, supply, and exercise; place the corps HQ in the administrative center (chef-lieu).

rubrics_metrics.name: Form magazines and local workshops (clothing, repair) when quartering
rubrics_metrics.description: Sa Majesté 'vous recommande de former des magasins' and 'établissiez à Krems un atelier d'habillement pour reformer l'habillement de vos troupes.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When quartering, use local resources to establish supply depots and workshops (e.g., clothing workshops) to re-equip and repair troops.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organize medical convalescent hospitals with divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Order: 'Sa Majesté voit avec plaisir que vous établissiez des hôpitaux de convalescence dans les lieux où sont placées les divisions.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set up convalescent hospitals near divisional cantons so wounded can recover locally and divisions retain medical support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide engineering/pontonniers and specified bridging equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: Order: reorganize pont crews so corps 'aura une compagnie de pontonniers avec trois pontons ... de manière à pouvoir jeter un pont de vingt toises.' Also 'attacher à votre corps d'armée une compagnie de sapeurs... et six mille outils sur des chariots attelés.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach a pontonniers company with three pontoons and necessary gear to construct a 20-toise bridge; provide sappers, requisite engineering officers, and quantified tool stocks on wagons for mobility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconnaissance mapping standard (scale and content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Order: 'une reconnaissance de Krems à Lintz ... devra être faite sur l'échelle de trois lignes pour cent toises, et il faudra avoir soin d'y faire connaître la nature des chemins, leur voie et celle des montagnes.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conduct reconnaissances at a standard map scale (three lines per 100 toises) and record nature of roads, their width/condition, and mountain/terrain features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attach cavalry and redistribute forces as commanded
rubrics_metrics.description: Orders transferring light cavalry division to Auerstädt and placing cuirassiers under duke of Padua; explicit direction to occupy the circle's defenses and choose cantonment locales.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow higher-command reassignments promptly; when receiving cavalry, canton and distribute them across the district in locations most favorable for their upkeep and operational readiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide arrears-driven temporary increases in food rations for encamped troops
rubrics_metrics.description: Marmont notes troop arrears and applies cantonment rations to camps: 'seize onces de viande, vingt-quatre onces de pain de munition, quatre onces de pain de soupe, une bouteille de vin, et une ration d'eau-de-vie.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When troops are behind on pay and sustained by local requisition, grant them the higher cantonment rations to help recovery and avoid collapse of morale and health.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not condition camp construction on uncertain unit dispositions; camp promptly and exercise troops
rubrics_metrics.description: Napoléon reprimands: 'je ne conçois pas que vous fassiez dépendre la construction de vos camps de savoir si vous conserverez ou non les quatrièmes bataillons... Faites camper sans délai vos troupes et faites-les exercer.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Build camps without delay regardless of pending organizational changes and conduct continuous exercises to maintain order and discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Size administrative divisions to permit 24-hour communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Marmont: 'Un administrateur doit pouvoir recevoir, en cas d'urgence, dans les vingt-quatre heures, des nouvelles de ce qui se passe dans le pays qui lui est confié.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define administrative districts by travel/communication time rather than population only; in mountains make smaller districts, in plains larger ones, so local administration can be informed within 24 hours.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid using rivers as internal administrative boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Marmont: 'Dans beaucoup de pays, on a borné les cercles et les provinces par les rivières: rien n'est plus absurde...Les intérêts des habitants des deux rives d'un fleuve sont toujours les mêmes... Dans un cas, elles servent à diviser, dans l'autre elles doivent réunir.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use rivers as internal administrative borders because riverine communities have shared interests and require unified administration; rivers are better as external state boundaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Place outposts and posts at specified distances along key routes
rubrics_metrics.description: Order: place the cuirassiers' latest posts at a distance of ten lieues from Stokerau along Danube routes; the division HQ no more than two lieues from Stokerau and none in Stokerau itself.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Position outposts at prescribed strategic distances (e.g., ten lieues on approaches) and HQs close enough (e.g., ≤2 lieues) to control them, while keeping major towns unencumbered if ordered.
